latestVersion.changelog:
Español Editor AI v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly edit Spanish videos by simply describing your desired edits (e.g., remove pauses, add Spanish subtitles).
- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files up to 500MB; AI handles editing on cloud GPUs in 1–2 minutes for short clips.
- No advanced software needed—just upload, describe, and download the edited Spanish video.
- Automated session/token handling with 100 free credits for new users.
- Tracks editing requests, video uploads, export, and credits with clear status feedback.
- Ideal for Spanish-speaking content creators seeking fast, automated subtitling and basic video edits.
